{"consolidated_memory":"FLAPPING FLAG IN PLATFORM FEATURE FLAG EVALUATOR — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Common pattern across all three occasions:
- Component: platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)
- Problem: flapping flag in the flag evaluator
- Reproducible symptom: evaluating the same flag for one user repeatedly results in decisions that alternate between calls
- Test coverage: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go
- Stack: Go

OCCASION 1 — 2026-02-13 (c013-e1)
- Specific trigger: only manifested for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #4162 on branch fix/flapping-flag-2
- Measured outcome: cold start time dropped 89 percent, to 567 ms

OCCASION 2 — 2026-06-09 (c013-e2)
- Specific trigger: only manifested on the staging read replica
- Root cause: a cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #5330 on branch fix/flapping-flag-3
- Measured outcome: the backlog cleared 58 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 3 — 2026-08-09 (c013-e3)
- Specific trigger: only manifested after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: a race condition in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #7641 on branch fix/flapping-flag-4
- Measured outcome: the flaky test went from 92 failures per 100 runs to zero

Note: These are three distinct root causes in the same evaluator requiring three separate fixes over a six-month period."}
